ticket.summary: Require fresh rates after the Ship To address changes
ticket.description:
When a seller changes the Ship To address of an order, the courier rates fetched earlier may be wrong for the new address, but the order can still be shipped with them.

Expected behaviour:
- After the Ship To address is saved, previously fetched rates are marked outdated.
- The seller sees the warning "Rates are outdated. Fetch new rates before shipping this order."
- The Ship button stays disabled until new rates are fetched and one is selected.
- Changing only the phone number or the order notes does not outdate the rates.
ticket.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Changing street, city, postcode or country marks rates as outdated and shows the warning.
2. Shipping is blocked until new rates are fetched and selected.
3. Changing the phone number or notes keeps the rates valid.

reference.title: Rates become outdated after the address changes
reference.expected: The warning is shown and the Ship button is disabled

reference.title: Ship after fetching new rates
reference.expected: The order ships with the new rate

reference.title: Change only the phone number
reference.expected: Rates stay valid and shipping is allowed
